response.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, AVG(1.0 * gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_avg FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.scan_count) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.avg_gb_per_minute - a.all_operator_avg) AS avg_margin_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE o.avg_gb_per_minute > a.all_operator_avg;

assumptions.assumption: A zero-minute scan has no defined GB-per-minute rate, so it is excluded from rate averages but still counts as a scan record.
